detail.longDescription: Uzbekistan and Oracle have discussed the development of cloud infrastructure, expansion of government data centre capabilities and introduction of advanced digital solutions in the country at a meeting in Tashkent, reports Trend. According to Uzbekistan's Ministry of Digital Technologies, the meeting was attended by Minister of Digital Technologies Sherzod Shermatov and Oracle representatives.
